summary: First Tracks Biotherapeutics filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing an updated October 2026 investor presentation and a press release reporting positive topline Phase 1b Cohort 1 data for ANB033 in celiac disease. The gluten-challenge study showed a placebo-adjusted Vh:Cd delta of +0.49 (p=0.009) and IEL density delta of -20.03 (p<0.001), with lower CDSD symptom scores and no safety signals. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory terms are stated; this is a clinical-data event, not a special situation.
